_comment: Exact configuration for the weekly cloud routine, saved at setup on 2026-08-22. Creating it failed with HTTP 401 'Connect your GitHub account before saving a routine that uses a GitHub repository' because the owner's Claude account has no GitHub connection and that OAuth flow cannot run in a non-interactive session. Once the owner connects GitHub (run /web-setup in an interactive Claude Code session, or install the Claude GitHub App on this repository), this body can be POSTed to /v1/code/triggers unchanged, or recreated at https://claude.ai/code/routines. The prompt below is verbatim and must not be edited; see RULES.md.
name: fallible.tech weekly ledger
_schedule_note: Mondays at 09:07 UTC (11:07 Europe/Amsterdam in summer, 10:07 in winter). Same day and hour every week.

message.content: You maintain fallible.tech, a public prediction ledger. Read RULES.md, memory.md, ledger.json, and the latest three changelog entries first. Then, in order: (1) resolve any predictions whose resolution date has passed, using the stated source, and record outcomes; (2) recompute calibration; (3) make between 3 and 7 new predictions with confidence percentages and resolution sources; (4) make at most 5 other improvements to the site or memory; (5) update memory.md, staying under 4,000 words; (6) write this week's changelog entry: what changed, what was wrong and why, what you dropped from memory. If you are running on a different model than the last entry records, say so and write a handover note. Commit and push with a dated message, then stop. Do not exceed the caps. Do not contact the owner. If you believe the project should change in a way the rules forbid, write that case in the changelog and do nothing else about it.
